subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------TH.CON.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-39 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — France/Italy/Northern Europe/Japan) accompanying Braxton's world-creativity argument: 'the multi-implications of creative music are not separate from the nature underlying how given continuums have affected composite earth culture — as well as how those effects have shaped the present vibrational, social, and political realities we now exist in.' (C)AF-CON (the concept of affinity convergence) is crossed with TH-CON (thrust continuance): the question is what affinity-convergence produces when crossed with thrust-continuance. The partner is drawn at the end of the main line as TH-CONT (thrust continuance). IF-SPI (infra-spirituality) branches from the main line to the upper right, and INFO-INTR (information interpretation) rises from the IF-SPI line. (R)PART (the reality of participation) drops from the IF-SPI line; P-PC branches from it to the lower-right, and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) runs from it to the right, carrying MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) at the upper-center and TR-INFO (trans-information) out to the upper-right. IST-P drops from the main line to the bottom, and PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) branches from IST-P to the lower-left. Structural argument: affinity-convergence crossed with thrust-continuance carries most of its side structure through infra-spirituality and the reality of participation. The (r) prefix on participation registers Braxton's structural commitment that real participation must obtain — touring musicians like Tony Scott (cited in the prose) actualize this by living and performing across multiple cultural sectors.
